title: New Life in Christ
definition: New Life in Christ is the believer's Spirit-given life that flows from union with the risen Savior.
summary: New Life in Christ is the believer's Spirit-given participation in the resurrection life of Jesus.
christFocus: Jesus Christ rose from the dead so believers may walk in newness of life.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
New life in Christ means salvation brings spiritual life where there was death. Scripture teaches that believers are not merely improved versions of their old selves; they are made alive with Christ.

This new life changes identity, desires, direction, and hope. It begins now by the Spirit and will be completed in resurrection glory.

Jesus is the risen Lord who shares His life with His people. Because He lives, those united to Him live also.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because people often reduce Christianity to behavior management or religious belonging. New life in Christ shows that the Gospel reaches deeper than habits; it creates a new person before God.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Live as someone made alive with Christ. Put away old patterns that belong to death, nourish your soul with Scripture and prayer, and walk in the new desires and obedience the Spirit is forming in you.
